tests.name: test_dense_spine_from_first_purchase_to_dataset_end
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) = 44 AND COUNT(DISTINCT (user_id, day)) = 44 AND COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE user_id = 3) = 0 AND MAX(day) = DATE '2026-02-10' AS ok FROM daily_rolling

tests.name: test_multiple_purchases_per_day_counted
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 AND day = DATE '2026-01-01' THEN daily_purchases END) = 2 AND MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 AND day = DATE '2026-01-31' THEN daily_purchases END) = 3 AS ok FROM daily_rolling

tests.name: test_7_day_window_boundary
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 AND day = DATE '2026-01-07' THEN rolling_7d_purchases END) = 3 AND MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 AND day = DATE '2026-01-08' THEN rolling_7d_purchases END) = 2 AND MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 AND day = DATE '2026-01-14' THEN rolling_7d_purchases END) = 1 AS ok FROM daily_rolling

tests.name: test_30_day_spend_boundary
tests.query: SELECT abs(MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 AND day = DATE '2026-01-30' THEN rolling_30d_spend END) - 22.0) < 1e-9 AND abs(MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 AND day = DATE '2026-01-31' THEN rolling_30d_spend END) - 30.0) < 1e-9 AS ok FROM daily_rolling

tests.name: test_rolling_7d_change
tests.query: SELECT COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rolling_7d_change IS NULL) = 2 AND MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 AND day = DATE '2026-01-08' THEN rolling_7d_change END) = -1 AND MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 1 AND day = DATE '2026-02-07' THEN rolling_7d_change END) = -3 AS ok FROM daily_rolling

tests.name: test_purchase_late_on_dataset_end_day_counts
tests.query: SELECT MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 2 AND day = DATE '2026-02-10' THEN daily_purchases END) = 1 AND abs(MAX(CASE WHEN user_id = 2 AND day = DATE '2026-02-10' THEN rolling_30d_spend END) - 21.0) < 1e-9 AS ok FROM daily_rolling
